title: Beyond the Boundaries of the Brain
summary: BE-BOB extended the lab's work on local gradients in brain organisation.
The project developed and tested the Vogt-Bailey Index, including validation with autism neuroimaging data.

figures.alt: Cortical maps and histograms compare local homogeneity estimates from ReHo on the left and the Vogt-Bailey Index on the right, with each colour scale retained.
figures.caption: Local homogeneity estimates using ReHo and the Vogt-Bailey Index. These maps demonstrate the methods. Interpolation can introduce artefacts, so the maps should not be used to infer motor-task activation.
figures.credit: Farrugia et al. (2024), Figure 5, Brain Structure and Function.
